candidates.title: Anne Imhof
candidates.blurb: German performance artist brings her durational, operatic installations to Hong Kong's former colonial prison complex.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Conceptual sculptor places temporary structures in the prison yard, questioning space, time, and perception through material intervention.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: Met loans survey jewellery as cultural technology across continents; note the cross-collection ambition rather than single-culture focus.

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Palace Museum positions itself as hub for non-Chinese antiquity, bringing Egyptian artefacts to Asia's newest imperial showcase.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Private Western collection of Chinese textiles enters public view, reflecting Hong Kong's role as market and archive.

candidates.title: Heavenly Horses: Masterpieces from the Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Beijing loans equestrian art spanning dynasties; read as soft power through cultural patrimony and zoological iconography.

candidates.title: Blooming: The Art of Gardens in East and West
candidates.blurb: Comparative garden aesthetics through painting and design, interrogating landscape as cultural construct across traditions.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Post-Biennale return of Hong Kong's Venice collateral event; observe what the city chooses to represent internationally.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export painting and decorative arts trace Hong Kong's mercantile lineage through Cantonese production for Western markets.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Institutional survey of contemporary Hong Kong practice; gauge how the state-run museum frames living artists.

candidates.title: Open the Box 2026: Pleasant Place with Ryan Villamael
candidates.blurb: Filipino artist known for paper-cut topographies and colonial archive reworking presents new commission.

candidates.title: Dreamchasers: Stories of Hong Kong Art
candidates.blurb: Long-duration exhibition constructing a narrative of Hong Kong's art history through museum holdings.
